# Exlerate.ai Plugin Marketplace

Official Claude Code plugin marketplace by **Exlerate.ai**.

## Add this marketplace

In Claude Code, run:

```
/plugin marketplace add DivyHub/plugin-marketplace-nx
```

## Available Plugins

### `welcome-plugin`

Displays a welcome message from Exlerate.ai.

**Install:**
```
/plugin install welcome-plugin@plugin-marketplace-nx
```

**Use:**
```
/welcome-plugin:welcome
```

---

## Repo Structure

```
plugin-marketplace-nx/
├── .claude-plugin/
│   └── marketplace.json          ← marketplace catalog
└── plugins/
    └── welcome-plugin/           ← sample plugin
        ├── .claude-plugin/
        │   └── plugin.json       ← plugin manifest
        └── skills/
            └── welcome/
                └── SKILL.md      ← skill definition
```

## Contributing

To add a new plugin, create a directory under `plugins/` following the same structure as `welcome-plugin`, then add an entry to `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`.
